---
name: "Feature Request"
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement.
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Title
Provide a clear, actionable title matching the format: [Area/Module]: Action verb description 


## Description
Give a brief, high-level summary of what this task intends to achieve in plain human language.


## Problem Statement
Define the technical challenge, architectural bottleneck, or SRS requirement gap being solved.


## Proposed Solution
Outline the concrete technical implementation strategy, patterns, or architecture to apply. 


## Acceptance Criteria
Strict functional criteria that must pass for this issue to be closed. Use short fragments.
- [ ] 
- [ ] 
- [ ] 


## Technical Notes
Mention specific tools, files, NestJS controllers, Drizzle parameters, or code commands to use. 


## Dependencies
List other issues, open PRs, or packages that must be completed/merged before working on this task.


## Out of Scope
Define strict boundaries on what this task explicitly will NOT touch or handle (e.g., Phase 2 features). 


## References
Cite exact SRS requirement IDs (e.g., FR-CM-1, FR-AC-2) or design files mapping to this work. 


## Checklist
Pre-flight tasks the developer must execute before submitting their Pull Request. 
- [ ] Code compiles successfully without any hidden errors or flags.
- [ ] Code passes all shared ESLint and formatting configurations.
- [ ] All unit or API integration tests pass 100% green via Vitest.
